FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Tire Pros Automotive Center, we specialize in tire sales, installation, balancing, and rotation for passenger vehicles and light trucks. Our services include basic automotive maintenance such as oil changes and battery replacements, ensuring that we deliver high-quality service while minimizing operational risks. We exclusively sell new tires sourced from reputable manufacturers, and all of our technicians are certified, receiving regular safety training to uphold industry standards. Our facilities feature a well-structured layout with a clear separation between customer areas and service bays, enhancing safety for both clients and staff. We adhere strictly to all environmental regulations regarding waste disposal, and we do not engage in towing, heavy-duty vehicle repairs, or the sale of used or salvaged tires, maintaining our focus on providing safe, reliable services.

Our Tire & Automotive Center offers comprehensive services, including towing and roadside assistance to help customers in need of immediate support with their vehicles.
